description: Submit the user's project to RoboDebut after the user authorizes submission and the required visible followed homepage badge is deployed. Requires the user's contact email. Creates or checks the existing proposal; never edits or publishes it. A badge does not prove ownership. Follow the submission instructions and returned status. Do not resubmit pending_review or repeatedly retry rejected domains.

contact_email.description: The user's contact address. Never invent it. RoboDebut keeps it private from public listings and excludes it from outputs and server logs. The calling MCP client still handles this input.

homepage_url.description: Public HTTPS apex or www homepage, without credentials or a custom port. Shared service validation normalizes to the root and registrable domain.

name: submit_project

optional_linkbunny_invitation.description: Optional invitation for the human. Include it when reporting pending_review; it does not authorize any LinkBunny action.

title: Submit a project for review
